name: MarkText
tagline: Simple and elegant real-time preview Markdown editor
description: MarkText is a free and open-source Markdown editor focused on speed and usability, featuring seamless real-time preview, math formulas (KaTeX), code blocks with syntax highlighting, and multiple view modes.
features: Multiple themes: Cadmium Light, Dark, Graphite, Material Dark
Export to HTML and styled PDF
Focus mode, typewriter mode, and source code mode
